note: Testnet FX venue. Exists because Arc has nowhere honest to convert: the one DEX there holds under $600 and its USDC/EURC pool quotes 2.2x off the real rate. MiniRouter and MiniPair reimplement the UniswapV2 curve at Solidity 0.8, since Uniswap V2 itself is 0.5/0.6 and does not build in this repo. Testnet only. Mainnet points the FXVenue interface at a real venue and the app does not change.

seeded.note: Faucet capped at 20 EURC, so this is the largest pool those balances allow. The ratio deposited is the price the pool trades at.

verified.note: The wallet's 200 bps guard passes up to about 0.398 USDC. A live swap of 0.40 USDC filled at 339855 EURC, exactly the quoted amount.
verified.depthWarning: 23 USDC of depth is shallow enough that one trade moves the price out of tolerance: the 0.40 USDC verification swap shifted the pool from 0.867 to 0.835 EURC per USDC and the guard then refused every size until the trade was reversed. Selling the proceeds back restored it, minus 0.6% of fees which stay with the LP and permanently narrow the window by roughly half a percent per round trip. Convert is demonstrable, not durable, until the pool is deeper.
